title: Fault-Level Workbook (openpyxl)
description: Upload a fault-results JSON (one entry per bus with currents per fault type) and a breaker rating, get a multi-sheet styled XLSX — one tab per fault type plus a Summary tab with formulas. Conditional formatting highlights any fault current that exceeds the breaker rating.

inputs.name: fault-results.json
inputs.description: Array of objects with keys: bus, voltage_kV, '3-phase', 'L-G', 'L-L', 'L-L-G' (kA each).

outputs.name: fault-level-study.xlsx
outputs.description: Styled multi-sheet workbook (one tab per fault type plus a Summary).

script:
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import CellIsRule
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

FAULT_TYPES = ['3-phase', 'L-G', 'L-L', 'L-L-G']
breaker_kA = float(params['breaker_kA'])

with open('/input/fault-results.json') as f:
    results = json.load(f)

wb = Workbook()
wb.remove(wb.active)

thin = Side(style='thin', color='AAAAAA')
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
header_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='1F2937')
header_font = Font(bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
breach_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FECACA')

for ft in FAULT_TYPES:
    ws = wb.create_sheet(title=ft)
    ws.append(['Bus', 'Voltage (kV)', f'I_fault {ft} (kA)', 'Breaker (kA)', 'Margin (%)'])
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
    for r in results:
        ifault = r.get(ft, 0.0)
        margin = (1 - ifault / breaker_kA) * 100 if breaker_kA else 0.0
        ws.append([r['bus'], r['voltage_kV'], ifault, breaker_kA, round(margin, 1)])
    rng = f'C2:C{len(results) + 1}'
    ws.conditional_formatting.add(rng,
        CellIsRule(operator='greaterThan', formula=[str(breaker_kA)], fill=breach_fill))
    for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = border
        max_len = max(len(str(ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value or ''))
                      for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1))
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col)].width = max_len + 4

summary = wb.create_sheet(title='Summary', index=0)
summary.append(['Bus', 'Max I_fault (kA)', 'Breaker margin (%)'])
for cell in summary[1]:
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.font = header_font
for row, r in enumerate(results, start=2):
    max_kA = max((r.get(ft, 0.0) for ft in FAULT_TYPES), default=0.0)
    margin = (1 - max_kA / breaker_kA) * 100 if breaker_kA else 0.0
    summary.cell(row=row, column=1, value=r['bus'])
    summary.cell(row=row, column=2, value=round(max_kA, 3))
    summary.cell(row=row, column=3, value=round(margin, 1))

wb.save('/output/fault-level-study.xlsx')
print('Wrote fault-level-study.xlsx for', len(results), 'buses (breaker', breaker_kA, 'kA)')
